name: labs/labpy__lantz
title: LabJack U12 USB DAQ (Lantz U12)
intro: LabJack U12 USB DAQ (Lantz U12), adapted from labpy/lantz. It reads `driver_version`, `firmware_version`, `analog_input_0`, `counter` and 2 more; sets `local_id`; runs `sample_voltages`, `set_analog_outputs`, `pulse_out` and `reset_device`. `sample_voltages`: acquire a block of analog input scans from channel 0 with aiBurst. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/labpy__lantz --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/labpy__lantz --backend fake --mcp
